claims.text: The Shard is a spectacular 95-storey skyscraper that stands out as the tallest building in both the United Kingdom and Western Europe.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Italian architect Renzo Piano designed the building to look like a spire emerging from the Thames, inspired by the masts of sailing ships.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Interestingly, the building got its name from critics who complained it would look like a shard of glass plunged into the heart of historic London.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: To achieve its stunning appearance, the facade is covered with 11,000 angled panes of glass designed to reflect the sunlight and sky.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The massive tower replaced an older 24-storey office block that was built on this exact site back in 1975.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: At a breathtaking height of 244 metres, visitors can step outside onto the open-air observation deck located on the 72nd floor.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: While you must book an entry timeslot, you can stay as long as you like at the top and even enjoy cocktails with the panoramic view.
claims.subject: self
